instruction: Pour the liquid from the first violet bottle into the first black bowl, from the second red bottle into the second white bowl, and from the third turquoise bottle into the third brown bowl. Then reset the robot arm.

arguments.note: Approach the violet bottle from the front, keeping its neck clear for pouring.

arguments.hindsight: The initial body grasp was too shallow. I should have opened before approaching, aligned the jaws across the bottle, verified a stable low lift, and transported upright with clearance before tilting only over the target bowl.
arguments.reason: The violet bottle slipped repeatedly and liquid spilled outside the requested black bowl; I cannot reliably complete the specified pours from this state.
